items.title: ns2_dmd_jambi
items.description:
Mod ID: 33305de3

DMD Version of Descent! As usual, we are modifying our favorite maps to give them a new dynamic.

Changes:
-takes longer to get to Gravity as a Marine

Have a suggestion? Let us know. We are always trying out new variations to keep NS2 interesting.

xtcmen (Jambi), Rusty, WiseChoices
